description: Ride together as a family, and look good doing it. The Chopper Goat KD is a purpose-built e-bike for kids ages 8–13 weighing up to 150lbs, designed to match your adventures while keeping young riders safe and in control. With a 20.5-inch seat height, 250W motor, and 36V 10AH battery, it delivers smooth, manageable power. Multiple speed settings let kids build confidence as they learn to master electric riding.
